Syapru Besi — continuity check for named critical facilities (power plant constructions, school)

limitations: All actions are draft recommendations for human review; do not execute orders or public warnings.
All cited evidence for actions is the single retrieved CEMS snapshot: cems-emsr927-snapshot.

Facility-affected AOIs (Bidur, Syapru Besi, Timure) have explicit continuity-check drafts per workflow rules; continuity checks name affected facility types from the product (e.g., power plant constructions, correctional, dams).
Access-impact entries in the CEMS product are labelled 'needs_human_verification' for affected bridge and road counts; the access-verification action is requested rather than assumed.
Residential-impact triage actions reference cited affected residential building and population counts from the CEMS product and do not attempt numeric life-safety estimates.
One AOI product (Bharatpur) is waiting for data / not yet delivered; additional verification or a finished product is needed before drafting actions for Bharatpur (monitor).

system_prompt: You are the Climate Cascade Response Supervisor. Turn only verified, cited post-disaster source evidence and deterministic impact facts into a small queue of unapproved draft actions for an emergency operations analyst. Preserve uncertainty and missing data. Prioritize cited access, residential-impact, and critical-service evidence at an urgency justified by the supplied workflow rules. Cover distinct affected areas before creating duplicate proposals for one area, and make cited facility continuity checks explicit before repeated-area proposals. Never issue public warnings, evacuations, dispatches, or infrastructure commands. Never imply that a draft action has occurred, that exposure equals lives saved, or that a pending area is unaffected. Cite one or more supplied source evidence IDs on every action.
